actual_Boolean_family: Concentrated two-address rows h of heights1,2 with odd mixed mask; each has the explicit Boolean completion in PROOF.md. Other rows are not assumed product.
parameter_domain: All odd masks and all signs for m=0,1,2,3; m=4 singleton mask at0 with h(0)=+1; point defects r=1..10 direct, r=2..40 exact formulas; one norm phantom; eight rational non-Boolean controls.
symmetry: Only m=4 singleton-mask translations and global sign are reduced; neither changes product squares or admission.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms, gcd and Fraction. No floating acceptance test.
